newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - GILTS LEAN TO DOWNSIDE, TEST 114-04 PROP.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - GILTS LEAN TO DOWNSIDE, TEST 114-04 PROP.

text.p: LIFFE September gilt futures will continue within their broad 114-00, 116-00 range on Thursday but with some downside bias, technical analysts said.
Fundamentals will also play a part with the result of the Bank of England monetary policy committee's regular meeting to decide interest rates due at 1100 GMT.

"If we do get a rate rise we will probably test the lower levels 114-04, 114-05 and if that area breaks then we could go down to the key 113-24 level," said Marc Ostwald, technical analyst at London Bond Broking here.
At 0706 GMT, September gilts were at 114-19, down 0.02.
The contract reached 113-24 just after the budget and that was likely to be the bottom of the market for now, Ostwald said.
"Gilts are trying to consolidate at the lower levels we have reached over the last two days. We are basically trading in a broad 114-00, 116-00 range," he said.
But Ostwald said there might be the opportunity to move higher and re-visit recent highs in the 114-25, 28 area.
"If we are going to start negating the negative trend we have got to get over that area," he said.
Above there he said further resistance was offered by the previous congestion area around 115-05,07.
"Those two regions could prove quite substantial hurdles for today, but if we can break those levels then in the longer run we could break back towards 115-24," Ostwald said.
Technical anlaysts at a European bank in London said gilts could see some further recovery but not above 116-00 for now.
"The market is relatively firm and we'd look for further recovery of at least half a point," they said in a research note.
To the downside they saw support at 114-00, 113-16, 17 and 113-00, and said it would have been technically satisfying to see 114-00 broken.
At the short end, December short sterling was at 92.59, up four basis points on the day.
